abstract: Configure Cline (VS Code, JetBrains, CLI) for self-hosted OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LiteLLM, llama-swap). Covers the OpenAI Compatible, Anthropic base-URL, Ollama and LiteLLM providers, key handling in ~/.cline, context and output limits, Compact Prompt, proxies and CA certificates, model-name mapping, tool-calling and streaming caveats, troubleshooting and a read-only probe script.
